summary: Peoples Bancorp Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its merger agreement to acquire Citizens National Corporation. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger, Citizens will merge into Peoples, and Citizens' bank subsidiary will merge into Peoples Bank. The filing does not disclose price per share, premium, or consideration type. The Board of Peoples declared its regular quarterly dividend of $0.42 per share separately. No advisors or break fee are named. The transaction adds 12 Kentucky branches to Peoples' network. To watch: regulatory approvals and shareholder votes, with risk-arb focusing on deal timeline and integration details.
